objective: GATE 2A del frente Servidores + Conexiones + Comunicaciones + Robot Universal + Toast + Internacionalizacion. Obtener evidencia SQL dirigida para cerrar el gap report SQL↔repo después del Gate 1 certificado. Confirmar exactamente estructuras reutilizables y gaps para empresa/unidad, conexión↔software↔versión, capacidades↔sync, secretos, identificadores externos, layouts/homologación, ejecuciones/evidencia, timezone IANA por unidad, locale/idioma, moneda/FX y RBAC. Solo SELECT/metadatos; no leer valores secretos; no DDL/DML; no cambios de repo/base; Production prohibida.

queries.name: organization_unit_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name IN ('Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_UnidadesNegocio','Sistema_UnidadesNegocioPerfilDigital') OR o.name LIKE '%Empresa%Unidad%' OR o.name LIKE '%Unidad%Perfil%') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: organization_unit_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.name IN ('Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_UnidadesNegocio','Sistema_UnidadesNegocioPerfilDigital') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: connection_software_version_columns
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.name IN ('Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Capacidades') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: connection_software_version_fk_graph
queries.sql: SELECT ps.name AS parent_schema,pt.name AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,rs.name AS referenced_schema,rt.name AS referenced_table,rc.name AS referenced_column,fk.is_disabled,fk.is_not_trusted FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables pt ON pt.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas ps ON ps.schema_id=pt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=pt.object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id=rt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=rt.object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE pt.name IN ('Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo') OR rt.name IN ('Servidores_Conexiones','Sistema_Tipos','Sistema_TiposVariantes','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_Empresas','Sistema_UnidadesNegocio') ORDER BY pt.name,fk.name,fkc.constraint_column_id

queries.name: sync_relationship_object_discovery
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND ((o.name LIKE '%Sync%' AND (o.name LIKE '%Version%' OR o.name LIKE '%Capacidad%' OR o.name LIKE '%Sistema%' OR o.name LIKE '%Conexion%')) OR o.name LIKE '%Capacidad%Sync%' OR o.name LIKE '%Version%Sync%') ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: sync_relationship_column_discovery
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (250) s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (c.name LIKE '%Sync%' OR c.name LIKE '%Capacidad%' OR c.name LIKE '%VersionSistema%' OR c.name LIKE '%Version_ID%' OR c.name LIKE '%Conexion_ID%') AND (o.name LIKE 'Sistema_%' OR o.name LIKE 'Servidores_%') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: secret_credential_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Secreto%' OR o.name LIKE '%Secret%' OR o.name LIKE '%Credencial%' OR o.name LIKE '%Credential%') ORDER BY o.name
